terms.comment: No reference work has a Latin word (Morgan–Owens’s heading antibiotic gives none). Antibioticum is the international pharmaceutical name, from Greek ἀντί, against, and βίος, life, and Latin speakers use it as it is; in speech the plain medicāmentum will often do.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. antibiotic (no Latin given).
